AminoAcidCooper2010Dataset: Cooper 2010 measured free amine-containing metabolite pools of the haploid MATa deletion collection after overnight growth in synthetic complete medium, by NBD-F derivatization and capillary electrophoresis with laser-induced fluorescence. One record is one deletion strain with 17 peak values, each a linear ratio to its plate average.
AminoAcidMulleder2016Dataset: Mulleder 2016 measured the intracellular concentration of 19 amino acids by LC-SRM/MS in 4,678 strains of the prototrophic yeast deletion collection grown exponentially on synthetic minimal agar. One record is one deletion strain with 19 batch-normalized concentrations in mM, against the population robust mean as reference.
BetaxanthinCachera2023Dataset: Cachera 2023 used CRI-SPA to transfer four betaxanthin biosynthesis genes into each strain of the yeast knockout (YKO) collection on YPD with G418, then scored colony yellowness by image analysis as a betaxanthin proxy. One record is one gene deletion with its 24 h corrected yellowness score, SE and replicate count.
BiofuelTiterBrunk2016Dataset: Brunk 2016 measured isopentenol, limonene and bisabolene titers in g/L over a batch fermentation of nine mevalonate-pathway E. coli DH1 strains sampled from 0 to 72 h in EZ-Rich defined medium with 1% glucose. Each strain carries one or two production plasmids whose gene parts are the perturbations. One of the 72 records is one strain at one sampling hour for its own fuel.
Bloom2019Dataset: Bloom 2019 phenotyped 13,950 haploid segregants from 16 biparental crosses by colony radius on solid plates in 38 growth conditions (carbon sources, stress compounds, pH, temperature). Each segregant is a haplotype mosaic of its two parents. One record is one segregant in one condition, mostly the radius residual against its matched control plate.
Boocock2025Dataset: Boocock 2025 profiled four segregant panels from Bloom 2019 crosses by 10x 3' single-cell RNA-seq, genotyping each cell from its transcribed SNPs. One record is either a pooled, previously genotyped BY x RM segregant (its cells summed into pseudobulk UMI counts) or one de novo segregant cell with its own counts and haplotype posterior.
CampaignProteomeCarruthers2025Dataset: Carruthers 2025 campaign proteome, read from the Dryad deposit of six automated design-build-test-learn cycles of multiplexed CRISPRi arrays on an isoprenol-producing KT2440 chassis. 465 records share the (construct, cycle) identity of the 465 titer records: one record is one strain-cycle's mean percent-of-proteome Top3 abundance, keyed by UniProt accession.
CarbonSourceTong2020Dataset: Tong 2020 pinned the Keio deletion collection and a small RNA and small protein deletion library at 1,536 colonies per plate on solid MOPS minimal agar carrying one carbon source, scanning every 20 min for 24 h at 37 C. Table S1A releases the normalized 24 h end-point growth of 3,796 strains on 30 carbon sources. One record is one deletion strain on one carbon source.
CarotenoidOzaydin2013Dataset: Ozaydin 2013 transformed the haploid BY4741 deletion collection with the carotenogenic plasmid YB/I/BTS1 (crtYB and crtI plus an extra BTS1 copy) and visually scored colony color, a beta-carotene proxy, on a -5 to +5 scale with wild type at 0. One record is one released plate row: a deletion strain and its color score.
CaudalPanTranscriptome2024Dataset: Caudal 2024 measured whole-transcriptome expression by RNA-seq in natural S. cerevisiae isolates of the 1002-genomes panel. Each of the 943 isolates with a Peter 2018 genome is a perturbation set off S288C (allele variants, gene presence, absence, loss of function). One record is one isolate with per-gene TPM and raw counts.
CellYieldDeChiara2022Dataset: De Chiara 2022 grew the 1,011 sequenced isolates of the Peter 2018 panel as colonies on 43 carbon and nitrogen environments, reporting growth from Supplementary Table 3. This store holds the absolute colony cell yield. Each isolate is a perturbation set off S288C, and one record is one isolate in one environment.
CrisprMagicLian2019Dataset: Lian 2019 built MAGIC, genome-scale CRISPRa, CRISPRi and CRISPRd guide libraries run by three orthogonal Cas effectors in one pooled host, and selected them in SED-URA/G418 with 5, 10 or 15 mM furfural over three iterative rounds. One record is one guide in one round: its mean log2 enrichment over three biological replicates.
CrisprPineneToleranceNiu2019Dataset: Niu 2019 tested up- and down-regulated pinene-response genes one at a time in E. coli BW25113(PT5-dxs) with a dCas9 activator and repressor, reading OD600 after 12 h in LB plus 0.5% pinene as a ratio against the no-guide control. This store holds the growth column, 54 records stored as a log2 ratio, one per targeted gene set and arm.
CrispriArrayYunus2026Dataset: Yunus 2026 sgRNA-array position study, Supplementary Tables S8 to S12: 25 records, one per multiplexed CRISPRi construct built with VAMMPIRE in the engineered isoprenol producer IY1452. Each of the five panels measures one representative protein as a DIA-NN Top3 ratio to the control strain, over three biological replicates with the sample SD.
CrispriChemgenChoe2025Dataset: Choe 2025 grew a 39,591-member sgRNA library covering all 4,198 MG1655 coding sequences in E. coli MG1655 carrying pdCas9, in LB and in LB plus a sub-inhibitory dose of each of twelve antibiotics, reading guide abundance by amplicon sequencing. One of the 470,502 records is one guide in one antibiotic, a log2 ratio of abundance against untreated LB.
CrispriChemgenSmith2016Dataset: Smith 2016 grew pooled dCas9-Mxi1 CRISPRi gRNA tiling libraries against 20 drug-partner genes in BY4741 in competitive growth, with and without ATc and with or without a small-molecule inhibitor, tracking guides by amplicon sequencing. One record is one pool, guide and drug condition: the ATc-induced log2 fold change and its variance.
CrispriCrossRachwalski2024Dataset: Rachwalski 2024 conjugated an arrayed collection of mobile CRISPRi plasmids targeting essential E. coli genes into BW25113 and BW25113 lpp, and three single knockdowns into the Keio deletion collection, reading normalized colony growth on solid LB or MOPS-glucose at 37 C. One of the 48,900 records is one strain in one medium at one anhydrotetracycline dose.
CrispriDifferentialProteomeYunus2026Data: Yunus 2026 global differential proteome of the CRISPRi strain knocking down the 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase subunit sucB, Supplementary Tables S4 and S5, which release 145 downregulated and 193 upregulated proteins. ONE record holds the 305 of 338 released keys that resolve to a locus, each a Top3 fold change over three replicates with its t-test p value.
CrispriGeneFitnessWang2018Dataset: Wang 2018 pooled a genome-scale library of 55,671 sgRNAs through five CRISPRi selections in E. coli MG1655: essentiality, auxotrophy, L-Trp biosynthesis, furfural tolerance and isobutanol tolerance. This store holds Supplementary Data 5, the median guide log2 fitness per BLASTN cluster with its Z score. One of the 20,158 records is one gene in one screen.
CrispriGuideFfaEnrichmentFang2025Dataset: Fang 2025 ran Wang 2018's genome-scale CRISPRi library through two rounds of Nile-Red fluorescence-activated cell sorting in an E. coli free-fatty-acid producing strain, counting guides by NGS before and after each sort. One of the 15,708 records is one guide in one round, a log2 enrichment of normalized reads after over before sorting.
CrispriGuideFitnessWang2018Dataset: Wang 2018 ran a genome-scale library of 55,671 sgRNAs plus 400 non-targeting controls through five pooled CRISPRi selections in E. coli MG1655: essentiality in LB, auxotrophy and L-Trp biosynthesis in MOPS, and furfural and isobutanol tolerance. One of the 240,481 records is one guide in one screen, a log2 read-count ratio centered on the control median.
CrispriKnockdownCui2018Dataset: Cui 2018 electroporated a library of about 92,000 sgRNAs targeting random NGG-PAM positions of the MG1655 chromosome into two MG1655 derivatives that differ only in dCas9 level, and grew each pool for 17 generations under anhydrotetracycline induction. One record is one guide in one screened strain, the released log2 fold change in guide abundance.
CrispriKnockdownYunus2026Dataset: Yunus 2026 CRISPRi knockdown screen, Supplementary Table S3, the 125-sample shotgun-proteomics panel of FluxRETAP-chosen and intuition-chosen targets in the engineered isoprenol producer IY1452, cultured 48 h in M9 with glucose. 102 records, one per CRISPRi strain: its own target protein as a DIA-NN Top3 ratio to the control strain, from one sample.
CrispriMormino2022Dataset: Mormino 2022 integrated a Haa1-based acetic acid biosensor into a pooled dCas9-Mxi1 CRISPRi library and FACS-enriched cells with the highest reporter signal in SC with 50 mM acetic acid at pH 3.5. One record is one of 12 isolated strains with one CRISPRi target and its categorical biosensor call against the library pool.
CrispriPanelProteomeYunus2026Dataset: Yunus 2026 per-strain Top3 protein panel from the hand-deposited Benchling table: 125 records, one per deposited CRISPRi strain row of the isoprenol producer IY1452, carrying 253 UniProt accession columns beside that row's titer. One record is one strain's absolute profile over 207 accessions, with the Control row's measured proteome as the reference.
CrispriScreenRousset2018Dataset: Rousset 2018 screened a pooled library of about 92,000 random-position sgRNAs in two E. coli MG1655 derivatives carrying inducible dCas9, releasing per-guide log2 fold changes for five screens: growth over 17 generations, challenge by phage lambda, T4 and 186cIts at MOI 1, and cosmid recovery after lambda transduction. One of the 92,252 records is one guide in one screen.
CrispriSegregantHale2024Dataset: Hale 2024 integrated a dCas9-Mxi1 CRISPRi guide library into 169 haploid segregants of a BY4716 x 322134S cross and the BY parent, and measured lineage fitness by double-barcode sequencing in two ATc-induced assays and one uninduced assay. One record is one double-barcode lineage in one assay, with its relative fitness and standard error.
DmMicroarraySameith2015Dataset: Sameith 2015 profiled double-deletion strains pairing general stress transcription factors (GSTFs) on two-channel microarrays against a common wild-type reference pool, each grown and profiled four times from two independent cultures. One record is one of 72 GSTF pairs with log2(mutant/reference) ratios over 6,169 genes.
DmfCostanzo2016Dataset: Costanzo 2016 crossed query mutants (deletions and temperature-sensitive alleles) to deletion and ts arrays by synthetic genetic array (SGA) and measured colony size at 26 or 30 C, four replicate colonies per screen. This store holds double-mutant fitness: one record is one query x array strain pair, 20,705,612 in all, with its SD.
DmfKuzmin2018Dataset: Kuzmin 2018 ran SGA screens at 26 C crossing query strains (single mutants marked with an ho deletion, or double mutants) to deletion and ts-allele arrays, scoring colony size. This store holds double-mutant fitness: 410,399 digenic query x array crosses plus 172 double-mutant query strains of the trigenic screens, each record one strain with its SD.
DmfKuzmin2020Dataset: Kuzmin 2020 ran SGA screens at 26 C crossing ho-marked single and double mutant query strains to deletion and ts-allele arrays, including pilot screens (Table S3). This store holds double-mutant fitness: 632,797 digenic query x array crosses plus 201 double-mutant query strains from Table S5, each record one strain with its fitness SD.
DmiCostanzo2016Dataset: Costanzo 2016 crossed query mutants (deletions and temperature-sensitive alleles) to deletion and ts arrays by synthetic genetic array (SGA) at 26 or 30 C, scoring colony size. This store holds the digenic genetic interaction score (epsilon) and its P-value: one record is one query x array gene pair, 20,705,612 records across four Data File S1 tables.
DmiKuzmin2018Dataset: Kuzmin 2018 ran SGA screens at 26 C crossing ho-marked query strains to deletion and ts-allele arrays, scoring colony size. This store holds the digenic genetic interaction score (epsilon) and its P-value from the raw data table: one record is one query x array gene pair, 410,399 records in all.
DmiKuzmin2020Dataset: Kuzmin 2020 ran SGA screens at 26 C crossing ho-marked query strains to deletion and ts-allele arrays, in a main screen (Table S1) and pilot screens (Table S3). This store holds the digenic genetic interaction score (epsilon) and its P-value: one record is one query x array gene pair, 632,797 records across both tables.
DoublingTimeCaglar2017Dataset: Caglar 2017 Table S5 releases the exponential-phase doubling time of wild-type E. coli B REL606 in 19 environments, taken as log base e of 2 over the slope of a linear fit to OD600. One record is one biological replicate growth curve, 55 in all, storing the doubling time in minutes with the released asymmetric 95% confidence limits.
DoublingTimeDeChiara2022Dataset: De Chiara 2022 grew the 1,011 sequenced isolates of the Peter 2018 panel as colonies on 43 carbon and nitrogen environments, reporting growth from Supplementary Table 3. This store holds the absolute colony population doubling time in hours. Each isolate is a perturbation set off S288C, and one record is one isolate in one environment.
EnvChemgenAuesukaree2009Dataset: Auesukaree 2009 screened the 4,828-strain haploid BY4742 KanMX deletion collection by serial-dilution spot assay on YPD plates for sensitivity to six stresses: ethanol, methanol, 1-propanol, 37 C heat, 1 M NaCl and 5 mM H2O2. Only sensitive hits are reported, so one record is one sensitive deletion x stress pair with a categorical call.
EnvChemgenCostanzo2021Dataset: Costanzo 2021 ran condition SGA screens of deletion and temperature-sensitive allele arrays in 14 environmental conditions (13 added compounds and galactose as an alternative carbon source) plus a matched reference condition, scoring colony size. One record is one mutant in one condition: its differential fitness against the reference condition.
EnvChemgenGirgis2009Dataset: Girgis 2009 propagated a library of about 5 x 10^5 single-insertion transposon mutants of E. coli MG1655 for several days in each of 17 antibiotics at growth-impairing doses, then read the surviving population by microarray genetic footprinting. One of the 66,287 records is one gene in one antibiotic, carrying the combined z-score of Dataset S5.
EnvChemgenHoepfner2014Dataset: Hoepfner 2014 profiled the heterozygous (HIP) and homozygous (HOP) kanMX4 deletion collections against 1,776 compounds, each in duplicate near its IC30, mostly proprietary Novartis CMB compounds. One record is one deletion strain under one compound dose and study, with its sensitivity score; 30,308,574 records.
EnvChemgenMota2024Dataset: Mota 2024 screened the haploid BY4741 Euroscarf KanMX deletion collection by spot assay on YPD agar at pH 4.5 and 30 C against 75 mM acetic, 14 mM butyric and 0.30 mM octanoic acid, scored against the parental strain. One record is one deletion x acid pair with an ordinal susceptibility grade (0, +, ++).
EnvChemgenNichols2011Dataset: Nichols 2011 pinned the Keio deletion collection, tagged and allele versions of essential genes and an sRNA library at 1,536 colonies per plate onto agar carrying one stress each, imaged the plates and scored every colony size. Table S2 releases 3,979 strain rows by 324 screen columns; one of the 1,286,962 records is one strain in one screen.
EnvChemgenParsons2006Dataset: Parsons 2006 grew the pooled MATa haploid deletion collection against 82 conditions (75 compounds and 7 crude natural-product extracts) and read strain abundance from uptag and downtag barcodes on Agilent arrays. One record is one of 4,111 deletion strains in one condition, with the released log2(control/treated) ratio, positive when sensitive.
EnvChemgenPiotrowski2017Dataset: Piotrowski 2017 profiled compound conditions from seven libraries against a 310-strain diagnostic pool of kanMX deletions in a pdr1 pdr3 snq2 drug-sensitized background, grown 48 h at 30 C in YP galactose and read by UPTAG barcode sequencing. One record is one strain in one condition with its chemical-genetic interaction z-score.
EnvChemgenShiver2016Dataset: Shiver 2016 pinned an arrayed E. coli K-12 mutant library onto agar plates carrying one stress each, quantified colony opacity with Iris, and assigned each mutant a signed fitness-score per condition. This store serves the study's own 57 conditions of S1 Dataset; one of the 210,998 records is one mutant strain in one condition.
EnvChemgenVanacloig2022Dataset: Vanacloig-Pedros 2022 grew a drug-sensitized barcoded yeast deletion library anaerobically against 45 released conditions, mostly plant-hydrolysate inhibitors, in biological triplicate beside paired inhibitor-free controls, counting barcodes. One record is one deletion in one condition: the mean log2(inhibitor/control) of TMM-normalized counts with its SD.
EnvChemgenWang2015Dataset: Wang 2015 grew the parent BW25113 and 46 of its Keio single-gene deletions, 45 multidrug-transporter genes plus tolC, in 2YT with and without 0.5% (v/v) isoprenol at 30 C and read OD600 after 12 h. One of the 46 records is one deletion strain, stored as the log2 of its Table S3 tolerance relative to the parent.
EnvChemgenWang2024Dataset: Wang 2024 grew a Tn5 insertion library of about 310,000 insertions in MG1655 to mid-exponential phase in LB, dosed three flasks with 2, 32 and 160 mg/L rifampicin, and recovered survivors 1 and 3 h later, comparing treated and input pools gene by gene by Tn-seq and TRANSIT resampling. One of the 26,514 records is one gene in one dose and time.
EnvChemgenWildenhain2015Dataset: Wildenhain 2015 screened compounds at 20 uM against sentinel BY4741 kanMX4 deletion strains, scoring growth inhibition by OD600; the released PubChem extension covers 5,518 compounds and 242 strains in duplicate. One record is one released screen of one strain against one compound, with its z-score against that strain's plate median.
EnvChemgenYoshikawa2009Dataset: Yoshikawa 2009 grew 4,729 MATalpha single-gene deletion strains one per well in static 96-well YPD at 30 C, adding water, ethanol (8% final) or NaCl (1 M final), and fitted specific growth rate from OD. Each strain was cultured twice per condition, and one record is one strain, condition and culture with its normalized growth rate.
EnvMetalTnseqRoyet2025Dataset: Royet 2025 mariner Tn-seq of KT2440: one saturated, non-barcoded transposon library grown 12 generations in LB at 28 C and in LB plus a sub-inhibitory dose of cobalt, copper, zinc or cadmium chloride. One record is one gene in one metal, TRANSIT's log2 fold change of insertion reads against LB over two pools; 21,583 of 22,916 cells are stored.
ExometaboliteBrunk2016Dataset: Brunk 2016 measured glucose and five organic acids by HPLC across a batch fermentation of nine mevalonate-pathway E. coli DH1 strains sampled from 0 to 72 hours in EZ-Rich defined medium. This store holds the six workbook columns labeled g/L; one of the 126 records is one strain at one sampling hour, referenced to the wild-type DH1 sample of that hour.
FattyAcidSmith2006Dataset: Smith 2006 screened the MATalpha haploid BY4742 KanMX deletion set on agar for peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation: clear-zone size on oleate (YPBO) and myristate (YPBM) plates, and growth on acetate (YPBA) as a control, in triplicate. One record is one deletion strain on one carbon source with its ordinal score.
FattyAcidXue2025Dataset: Xue 2025 is an in-house screen of a free fatty acid chassis (BY4741 with POX1, FAA1 and FAA4 deleted) carrying one to three further transcription factor deletions from 10 TFs, assayed by GC for absolute titer. One record is one genotype with mg/L titers of five FFAs (C14:0, C16:0, C18:0, C16:1, C18:1), mean and SE of three replicates.
FitnessBrowserEcoliDataset: Price 2021 released six GapMind samples through the Fitness Browser: a Keio ML9a transposon library grown on a defined no-carbon base with D-mannitol at 10, 5 and 2.5 mM as the sole carbon source, in duplicate. This loader serves the browser's BW25113 experiments that no other release covers; one record is one released locus in one sample, a signed log2 gene fitness.
FitnessBrowserPutidaDataset: Fitness Browser RB-TnSeq of KT2440, keyed by publication: 234 samples of ten attributed studies, 1,118,052 records, one per locus and sample. One record is the browser's gene fitness for that locus's transposon insertion mutants in the sample's own barcoded library, with the moderated t statistic, under the sample's medium and carbon, nitrogen or stress variable.
FitnessContrastBorchert2023Dataset: Borchert 2023 two-arm RB-TnSeq fitness contrasts of the barcoded KT2440 transposon library, released as 13 comparison sheets with three replicate cultures per arm. 64,853 records, one per gene in one comparison of a condition arm against a reference arm, carrying the released t statistic, p value, q value and adjusted q value of the two-sample t test.
FluxIshii2007Dataset: Ishii 2007 ran 13C metabolic flux analysis on one set of glucose-limited chemostat cultures of E. coli K-12: 24 Keio single-gene disruptants at 0.2 per hour plus the wild type at 0.1, 0.4, 0.5 and 0.7 per hour. One of the 28 records is one culture's fitted net-flux map over the release's own 43 net reactions, as a percentage of the glucose uptake rate.
FluxLi2021Dataset: Li 2021 replaced the native zwf promoter of the mevalonate-producing EP-bifido strain BW-P with synthetic promoters and ran 13C metabolic flux analysis on three of them. One of the three records is one strain's released network block: 99 net fluxes in mmol/gdw/h with their 90% bounds, against the unreleased BW-P BF control map.
GeneEssentialityBaba2006Dataset: Baba 2006 targeted 4,288 ORFs of E. coli K-12 BW25113 for in-frame replacement by a kanamycin cassette and kept the mutants whose kanamycin-resistant colonies had the expected PCR structure, the Keio collection. One record is one targeted ORF on the selection plates: 3,985 yielded a deletion and 303 did not, the paper's essential gene candidates.
GeneEssentialityGerdes2003Dataset: Gerdes 2003 mutagenized E. coli MG1655 with the EZ::TN KAN-2 transposome, grew the pool for 23 population doublings in a fermentor, and mapped the surviving insertions by nested PCR. Table S1 calls each ORF essential, non-essential, not covered or ambiguous; one of the 3,739 records is one gene with a boolean call, 619 of them essential.
GeneEssentialityGoodall2018Dataset: Goodall 2018 built a mini-Tn5 transposon library of about 3.7 million mutants in E. coli BW25113, sequenced the transposon junctions by TraDIS, and called each protein-coding gene from its insertion index. This store holds the essential and non-essential calls of two conditions, the library as plated and after outgrowth in LB broth, one record per gene and condition.
GeneEssentialityPrice2018EcoliDataset: Price 2018 likely-essential genes of the E. coli BW25113 RB-TnSeq library KEIO ML9, from Supplementary Table 1: a gene is called essential or nearly essential when the fitness analysis gave it no value and its insertion and read densities were both under 0.2, on LB plates at 37 C. One record is one called gene, 324 in all.
GeneEssentialitySgdDataset: Built from SGD per-gene phenotype annotations: every annotation with mutant type null, strain S288C and phenotype inviable is one record. The allele is a whole-gene deletion or, for 42 annotations, a named point, truncation or internal-deletion allele, and any curated condition is kept. Each record carries the SGD experiment type as essentiality evidence.
GeneInteractionBabu2014Dataset: Babu 2014 eSGA genetic interactions in E. coli K-12: 163 Hfr Cavalli donor query mutants were conjugated into an arrayed F- Keio recipient collection and double-mutant colony sizes were scored as a signed interaction score S. One record is one Table S2 donor-recipient gene pair, of 42,705 high-confidence pairs (25,239 aggravating, 17,466 alleviating).
GeneInteractionButland2008Dataset: Butland 2008 eSGA genetic interactions in E. coli K-12: 39 Hfr Cavalli query deletions were each conjugated into an arrayed F- recipient collection of 8,073 strains, Keio deletions plus SPA-tagged essential genes. One record is one cell of the unfiltered 39 x 8,073 matrix of S scores in Supplementary Table 4, so non-significant pairs are kept.
GenomeArchitecturePuddu2019Dataset: Puddu 2019 whole-genome sequenced colonies of the homozygous diploid yeast knockout collection and released copy numbers of rDNA, CUP1, mtDNA, 2 micron and five Ty families, a telomere-length proxy, all 16 chromosomes and a rearrangement count. One record is one sequenced knockout colony, 8,835 over 4,458 deletion strains.
GradedGeneEssentialityGoodall2018Dataset: Goodall 2018 TraDIS essentiality of a mini-Tn5 library of about 3.7 million mutants in E. coli BW25113, called from each gene's insertion index by a mixture likelihood ratio, as plated on LB agar (TL) and after outgrowth in LB broth. This class holds the 317 calls of unclear, one record per gene and condition, with insertion index and likelihood ratio.
GradedGeneEssentialityRoyet2025Dataset: Royet 2025 Table S4: the TRANSIT HMM essentiality call of every KT2440 gene from the mariner Tn-seq library, 5,729 genes over two stages, 11,458 records. One record is one gene at one stage, the library as plated on LB agar or after outgrowth in LB, storing the released state with its TA sites, insertion rate and mean read count.
GrowthAucRapp2026Dataset: Rapp 2026 growth of an arrayed E. coli CRISPRi library (dCas9 host YYdCas9) covering the 1,515 genes of the iML1515 model: the area under each strain's OD600 curve over three replicate cultures, divided by the mean AUC of 48 control curves. One record is one knockdown strain, 1,515 in all, 18 of them without a metabolome sample.
GrowthRateCampos2018Dataset: Campos 2018 growth of 3,664 imaged strains of the E. coli Keio single-gene deletion collection, grown in 96-well plates in M9 with 0.1% casamino acids and 0.2% glucose at 30 C. One record is one deletion strain, its Gompertz maximal growth rate as a ratio to the BW25113 parent, of which 240 replicates were grown alongside.
GrowthRateChoe2019Dataset: Choe 2019 growth rates from the genome-reduced E. coli MS56 study, Source Data Fig. 2c and 2f: the MS56 Δ21kb and ΔrpoS deletions, three single-allele strains (cspC, ilvN, yifB) against kan-marked controls, MS56 over MG1655 and the evolved clone eMS57 over MS56. One record is one strain as a ratio to its parent, eight in all.
GrowthRateLamoureux2023Dataset: Lamoureux 2023 growth rates from the PRECISE-1K E. coli RNA-seq sample metadata: wild-type MG1655, gene deletions, rpoB substitutions, evolved isolates, BW25113 and pColi construct samples across many conditions. One record is one released sample's absolute growth rate in 1/hr, 354 in all, against a wild-type M9 glucose base condition.
GrowthRateS23Schmidt2016Dataset: Schmidt 2016 Table S23 growth rates of wild-type E. coli BW25113, MG1655 and NCM3722 across the growth conditions of the proteome map, including chemostat and stationary-phase arms. One record is one strain in one condition, its absolute growth rate in 1/h with the released Stdev, against that strain's glucose row.
GrowthRateSchmidt2016Dataset: Schmidt 2016 Table S24 growth rates of the Keio rimI, rimJ and rimL deletion strains of E. coli BW25113 in glucose and in acetate medium, with up to three replicates each. One record is one deletion strain in one medium, its growth rate as a ratio to the wild type in the same medium, with the sample SD; six records in all.
GrowthWang2015Dataset: Wang 2015 Table S3 growth of 46 E. coli Keio transporter deletion strains of BW25113 in plain 2YT medium without isoprenol, read as 12 h endpoint OD600. One record is one deletion strain, its OD600 as a ratio to the BW25113 parent with the scaled sample SD; the isoprenol tolerance arm is a separate dataset.
GrowthYieldBaba2006Dataset: Baba 2006 Table 3 growth yields of the obtained E. coli Keio single-gene deletion mutants of BW25113: OD600 after 22 h in LB with kanamycin and after 24 h and 48 h in 0.4% glucose MOPS with kanamycin. One record is one mutant in one of those three cultures, 11,735 single readings with no released replicate dispersion.
HetHillenmeyer2008Dataset: Hillenmeyer 2008 (FitDb) grew the barcoded heterozygous (HIP) deletion collection, one allele replaced by kanMX4 in BY4743, competitively under chemical and environmental conditions read on barcode arrays. This store holds the HIP fitness-defect log2 ratio against matched control arrays: one record is one constructed strain on one treatment array.
HomHillenmeyer2008Dataset: Hillenmeyer 2008 (FitDb) grew the barcoded homozygous (HOP) kanMX4 deletion collection in BY4743 competitively under chemical and environmental conditions read on barcode arrays. This store holds the HOP fitness-defect z-score against a matched control array set, since no HOM log ratio was archived: one record is one constructed strain on one treatment array.
InductionTimecourseHackett2020Dataset: Hackett 2020 placed each of about 200 S. cerevisiae regulators under a beta-estradiol-inducible synthetic promoter, grew each strain to steady state in a chemostat, induced with 1 uM beta-estradiol and profiled RNA on two-color Agilent arrays over time. One record is one array: one time course at one time point, as cleaned log2 ratio versus the same culture at t = 0.
IsobutanolScreenLopez2024Dataset: Montaño López 2024 integrated a GFP isobutanol-pathway biosensor under the LEU1 promoter into every strain of the BY4741 yeast knockout collection and read median fluorescence by flow cytometry in liquid SC medium. This first genome-wide screen measured each strain once; one record is one released row, the fold change over the same-plate wild-type control (4,805 rows).
IsobutanolValidatedLopez2024Dataset: Montaño López 2024 re-screened the strong hits of the isobutanol-biosensor knockout screen (66 up at fold change 2 or more, 161 down at 0.5 or less) in triplicate by flow cytometry in liquid SC medium. One record is one deletion strain: its median GFP fluorescence fold change over the same-plate wild type, with SE from the released sample SD over three replicates (Table S3).
IsolateGrowthPeter2018Dataset: Peter 2018 phenotyped 971 sequenced natural S. cerevisiae isolates by end-point colony growth on solid medium under 35 stress, carbon-source and temperature conditions. One record is one isolate on one condition: its colony size divided by its own colony size on YPD at 30 C, with the isolate genotype built as sequence variants and gene presence off S288C (33,985 records).
IsopentenolTiterFoo2014Dataset: Foo 2014 isopentenol (isoprenol) titers of E. coli DH1 production strains carrying the mevalonate-pathway plasmids pJBEI-6830 and pJBEI-6833 plus one of eight genes whose overexpression shortened the isopentenol growth lag, or an RFP control, induced with 500 uM IPTG. One record is one strain's 48 h titer over triplicates, nine in all.
IsoprenolSelectionMenasalvas2025Dataset: Menasalvas 2025 growth-coupled selection: a pooled dCpf1 CRISPRi library, three guides per gene, run through two sequential rounds of an isoprenol biosensor whose mCherry reporter was replaced by pyrF, on an isoprenol-producing KT2440 chassis. 58 records, one per enriched knockdown target of Supplementary Tables 1 and 2, stored as a categorical enriched call.
IsoprenolTiterBanerjee2024Dataset: Banerjee 2024 isoprenol titers of a genome-scale-model-guided KT2440 campaign, taken from the article body because no released file is a measurement table. 20 records, one per strain in one condition, over five families: EZ rich plus glucose tubes, M9 minimal, a 2 L fed-batch bioreactor and sorghum hydrolysate.
IsoprenolTiterCarruthers2025Dataset: Carruthers 2025 isoprenol titer over six automated design-build-test-learn cycles of multiplexed CRISPRi arrays on the KT2440 chassis IY1449b carrying the pIY670 mevalonate pathway. 502 records: 465 campaign strain-cycles plus 37 Source Data panel strains, each with the sample SD over its triplicate cultures. The 90 control cultures are the per-cycle reference.
IsoprenolTiterDeSiqueira2025Dataset: de Siqueira 2025 Table S2, the maximum isoprenol titer in mM taken over the 24, 48 and 72 h samples of the isoprenol-catabolism-deficient strain PT and its acetate-tolerized Sigma isolates carrying the plasmid pIY670. 10 records, one per strain in one medium the library holds, each over three biological replicates with no released uncertainty.
IsoprenolTiterYunus2026Dataset: Yunus 2026 per-strain isoprenol titer from the hand-deposited Benchling table, the only released per-strain titer of this CRISPRi knockdown panel in the engineered producer IY1452, cultured 48 h in 5 mL M9 with glucose. 125 records, one per deposited strain row; the Control row's released 845.73 mg/L is the reference.
IsoprenolToleranceLim2025Dataset: Lim 2025 isoprenol tolerance from a 16-lineage tolerization evolution campaign on KT2440 and two stacked deletion strains. Three records: IPL300 and IPL400 at the 4 g/L starting dose from Supplementary Table 3's initial growth rates, and a reverse-engineered single-deletion strain at 6 g/L, each a log2 growth-rate ratio to KT2440 by the liquid-OD assay.
IsoprenylAcetateTiterKang2026Dataset: Kang 2026 isoprenyl acetate titers by GC-FID from the isoprenol chassis PIPA engineered with a heterologous alcohol acetyltransferase, three esterase deletions, an integrated xylose isomerase pathway and an acetyl-CoA module. 26 records: seven Table 1 flask maxima, five Table S4 tube endpoints at 48 h, and the fed-batch course's ester sums and isoprenol values.
LactamGrowthRateThompson2019Dataset: Thompson 2019 Supplementary Table S1: the maximal specific growth rate in per hour of KT2440 and two deletion mutants on each of three 10 mM carbon sources, glucose, 5-aminovalerate and valerolactam, grown plasmid free. Nine records, one per strain on one carbon source, including three released zeros; each reference is the same strain on glucose.
LifeCycleDeChiara2022Dataset: De Chiara 2022 phenotyped the 1,011 sequenced natural S. cerevisiae isolates for the sexual and aging parts of the life cycle. One record is one isolate under one assay protocol, a time course: sporulation efficiency and dyad fraction in potassium acetate (24 h, 72 h), sporulation in PBS, or stationary-phase viability in PBS, SDC or calorie-restricted SDC.
MetaboliteDaSilveira2014Dataset: da Silveira dos Santos 2014 measured lipidomes of 127 nonessential protein kinase and phosphatase deletion mutants by mass spectrometry (MRM-MS and Orbitrap for 147 acyl-chain-resolved glycero- and sphingolipid species, GC-MS for ergosterol). One record is one mutant: relative lipid abundances in arbitrary units, referenced to the mean of three measured wild-type strains.
MetaboliteGrowthPhaseMenasalvas2025Datas: Menasalvas 2025 data S1-1, growth-phase arm: absolute intracellular metabolite concentrations in uM, averaged over three biological replicates, of the control TEAM-2595 and the two improved isoprenol producers TEAM-3174 and TEAM-3185 harvested at OD600 0.7. Three records, one per strain, each over 46 of the sheet's 48 absolute rows.
MetaboliteIntensityRapp2026Dataset: Rapp 2026 absolute flow-injection MS intensities from the arrayed E. coli CRISPRi library covering the iML1515 genes: the Table S5 annotated m/z features that accumulate in a knockdown strain, as the mean of two plate replicates with their standard error. One record is one strain, 407 records holding 1,375 values, against its batch median intensity.
MetaboliteProductionPhaseMenasalvas2025D: Menasalvas 2025 data S1-1, production-phase arm: the same absolute uM concentrations over three biological replicates, on the control TEAM-2595 and the improved isoprenol producers TEAM-3174 and TEAM-3185 harvested at 24 h. Three records, one per strain, over 46, 46 and 47 metabolites; the two phases are two environments, hence two datasets.
MetaboliteZelezniak2018Dataset: Zelezniak 2018 measured the targeted central-carbon and amino-acid metabolome of 95 kinase-deletion strains of S. cerevisiae plus wild type by LC-SRM under three protocols with different units and cultures. One record is one strain under one protocol: per-metabolite mean and standard error over replicates, referenced to wild type measured under the same protocol.
MetabolomeBrunk2016Dataset: Brunk 2016 LC-MS metabolite concentrations from a 0 to 72 h flask time course of nine E. coli DH1 strains in EZ-Rich medium with 1% glucose: isopentenol, limonene and bisabolene producers carrying mevalonate-pathway plasmids, plus wild type. One record is one strain at one sampling hour, its 51 metabolites in uM, 117 records in all.
MetabolomeFuhrer2017Dataset: Fuhrer 2017 metabolome of the E. coli Keio single-gene deletion collection (BW25113), grown on glucose minimal medium with casein hydrolysate at 37 C, harvested mid-exponentially and measured by flow-injection TOF-MS over 3,169 negative-mode and 4,365 positive-mode ions. One record is one deletion strain column, 3,806 in all, with a modified z-score per ion.
MetabolomeIshii2007Dataset: Ishii 2007 CE-TOFMS intracellular metabolite concentrations in mM from glucose-limited chemostat cultures of E. coli K-12: 24 Keio single-gene disruptants at a dilution rate of 0.2 h-1 plus the wild type at 0.1, 0.4, 0.5 and 0.7 h-1. One record is one culture, 28 in all; the proteome and 13C fluxes of the same cultures are separate datasets.
MetabolomeRapp2026Dataset: Rapp 2026 flow-injection MS metabolome of an arrayed E. coli CRISPRi library covering all 1,515 iML1515 genes, with dCas9 induced by anhydrotetracycline and growth on M9 glucose at 37 C, over 3,026 extracts. One record is one knockdown strain, holding each annotated m/z feature's linear fold change over the batch median, averaged over two plates.
MetabolomeSchastnaya2021Dataset: Schastnaya 2021 flow-injection TOF-MS metabolome of E. coli strains carrying MAGE phosphosite substitutions on 23 enzymes, plus matching Keio deletion strains, each grown on M9 with one of five carbon sources. One record is one strain on one carbon source: the log2 fold change of each of 464 annotated ions over the MG1655 wild type, 200 records in all.
MicroarrayKemmeren2014Dataset: Kemmeren 2014 profiled single-gene deletion mutants of S. cerevisiae (1,484 in its Table S1) on two-color microarrays against a common wild-type reference RNA pool, two independent cultures each hybridized in dye-swap for four measurements per mutant. One record is one deletion strain: per-gene log2 ratio versus the reference pool, stored as liquid SC at 30 C.
MicroarrayScoreHu2007Dataset: Hu 2007 profiled S. cerevisiae transcription-factor deletion strains (BY4741, KanMX) grown to mid-log in YPD against a wild-type reference on two-color spotted cDNA arrays (GEO GSE4654). One record is one deletion strain: the released error-model X score and its p-value for each of 6,429 array elements, averaged over at least two replicate arrays.
MismatchCrispriFitnessHawkins2020Dataset: Hawkins 2020 mismatch-CRISPRi in E. coli: essential genes knocked down by dCas9 with fully complementary and singly mismatched sgRNAs, competed as a pool in LB with 1 mM IPTG at 37 C for about 10 doublings. One record is one sgRNA, its mean relative fitness over 4 biological replicates, 24,186 records; the predicted guide activity is not stored.
MorphologyCampos2018Dataset: Campos 2018 cell morphology of 3,664 imaged strains of the E. coli Keio single-gene deletion collection, grown in M9 with casamino acids and glucose at 30 C. One record is one deletion strain holding 26 features from Dataset EV2 (19 morphological, 2 growth, 5 cell cycle), with the number of segmented cells as its sample count.
MrnaFractionBalakrishnan2022Dataset: Balakrishnan 2022 RNA-seq transcriptome of E. coli NCM3722 and three NCM3722 derivatives at steady state across three growth-limitation series (C-, A- and R-limitation). One record is one released sample column, 28 in all, holding the mRNA number fraction of each of 4,342 genes, a dimensionless value that sums to 1 over the sample.
NadalRibellesPerturbSeq2025Dataset: Nadal-Ribelles 2025 rebuilt the yeast knockout collection with RNA-readable genotype barcodes (KanMX4 replaced by URA3) and profiled over 3,500 nonessential deletions by microwell single-cell RNA-seq in YPD and in 0.4 M NaCl osmostress. One record is one barcoded genotype in one condition: pseudobulk log2 fold change versus wild type, cell-to-cell dispersion and cell count.
Nguessan2025Dataset: N'Guessan 2025 grew 4,489 F2 segregants of a BY4741 x RM11-1a cross together in YPD and profiled them in one 10x 3' single-cell RNA-seq run, assigning each cell to a segregant by its transcribed SNPs. One record is one segregant (2,951 in all): the summed UMI counts of its assigned cells, with its genotype as RM-allele posteriors at 41,594 SNPs.
OrganicAcidYoshida2012Dataset: Yoshida 2012 screened the S. cerevisiae haploid deletion collection for organic-acid overproducers and quantified 17 gene deletions (KanMX4) by HPLC. One record is one deletion strain: titers in mM of acetate, citrate, malate, pyruvate, succinate and phosphate, mean of three independent experiments, referenced to the measured BY4742 wild type (Table 3).
PhageRbTnseqMutalik2020Dataset: Mutalik 2020 RB-TnSeq of the E. coli BW25113 transposon library KEIO ML9 challenged with 14 double-stranded DNA phages at a range of multiplicities of infection, in liquid and on solid agar, read out by Bar-seq. One record is one gene in one experiment, its normalized log2 abundance change, over 68 phage assays and 10 no-phage controls.
PhosphositeIntensityPotel2018Dataset: Potel 2018 measured the E. coli W3110 phosphoproteome by mass spectrometry, releasing MaxQuant precursor intensities for 2,129 phosphosites (S, T, Y and H) in 12 samples: glucose or glycerol, exponential or stationary phase, three replicates. One record is one sample column carrying all 2,129 sites as released; a released 0 is the typed status not quantified.
PineneFoldChangeNiu2019Dataset: Niu 2019 targeted pinene-response genes one at a time in E. coli BW25113(PT5-dxs) with a dCas9 MCPSoxS CRISPR activator or repressor, and quantified pinene by GC-FID after a 72 h SBMSN shake-flask run under a dodecane overlay. One record is one target gene set and arm: the released titer ratio over the no-guide control, with its sample SD over three replicates.
PooledPromoterExpressionVaishnav2022Data: Vaishnav 2022 measured expression of 71,158 promoter sequences by a pooled sort-seq reporter assay: an 80 bp variable insert in a 110 bp scaffold drives YFP from a low-copy CEN plasmid in S. cerevisiae grown in SC-Ura. One record is one library sequence: the sequence as genotype and its estimated expression level (104 released as NA).
PromoterReporterMohiuddin2022Dataset: Mohiuddin 2022 grew a 1,930-well E. coli MG1655 promoter-GFP reporter collection in 96-well plates, dosed early stationary phase with ampicillin, ofloxacin or gentamicin or left it untreated, and read GFP hourly from hour two to hour ten. One record is one arm, plate, well and read hour, the released plate-reader GFP value for that promoter.
ProteinFoldChangeCaglar2017Dataset: Caglar 2017 differential proteomics from LC-MS/MS of wild-type E. coli REL606 grown on Davis minimal medium across carbon sources and Mg2+ and Na+ levels. One record is one Table S8 protein contrast under the paper's primary design: a growth phase and single-dose test level against the glucose base group, 8 records kept as released.
ProteinSynthesisRateLi2014Dataset: Li 2014 used ribosome profiling to quantify absolute protein synthesis rates in E. coli MG1655 growing in MOPS glucose medium with the full Neidhardt supplement, the same supplement without L-methionine, and no supplement. One record is one medium, wild type, holding Table S1's plain integer rates in molecules per generation for 3,041, 3,362 and 2,241 genes.
ProteinTurnoverGupta2024Dataset: Gupta 2024 switched a steady-state E. coli NCM3722 culture to 15N ammonium and followed the peak shift by TMTproC complement-reporter proteomics, fitting one turnover parameter per protein in each of 13 growth conditions. One record is one condition, holding the released total half-life in hours, for 3,262 proteins across the release.
ProteinTurnoverMuenzner2024Dataset: Muenzner 2024 measured protein turnover in 55 natural S. cerevisiae isolates of the 1,011-genomes panel by dynamic SILAC in synthetic minimal medium. One record is one isolate: per-protein turnover rate kdp (1/h) and half-life (h), computed without growth-dilution correction, so the rate is total replacement (SI Table 17).
ProteomeBanerjee2025Dataset: Banerjee 2025 DIA shotgun proteome of the p-coumarate growth-coupling cutset in a KT2440 chassis, read from four released t-test workbooks naming six distinct groups. Six records, one per strain and medium sample: two promoter-titration strains of the rate-limiting fourth cutset gene against their parent, and its deletion strain in p-CA with alanine and malate.
ProteomeBrunk2016Dataset: Brunk 2016 sampled one batch fermentation of nine E. coli DH1 strains, the wild type plus three isopentenol, three limonene and two bisabolene producers, from 0 to 72 hours. This class holds the selected-reaction-monitoring peak areas of all 68 host proteins, one record per strain and sampling hour, 81 records.
ProteomeCaglar2017Dataset: Caglar 2017 measured the proteome of wild-type E. coli REL606 by LC-MS/MS across 34 Davis minimal medium conditions: four carbon sources, Mg2+ and Na+ series, exponential and stationary phase, and two starvation time courses. One record is one Table S3 sample, 105 in all, holding size-factor-normalized spectral counts keyed by ECB locus tag.
ProteomeCarruthers2025Dataset: Carruthers 2025 off-target study proteome, the Source Data's only abundance matrix: 20 sample groups, three replicates each, over 1,501 protein groups from IY1452b knockout strains carrying sgRNAs against candidate off-target genes. 21 records, one per released sample, each an absolute DIA-NN Top3 profile over 1,424 keys that resolve to the pinned assembly.
ProteomeDeSiqueira2025Dataset: de Siqueira 2025 Data Set S1 on the Top3 scale: DIA-NN Top3 peptide signal of KT2440, the isoprenol-catabolism-deficient PT and four acetate-tolerized evolved isolates, harvested in exponential growth in M9 with acetate, glucose or both. 17 records, one per sample over 1,730 protein groups with the SD over three replicates.
ProteomeFoldChangeCarruthers2025Dataset: Carruthers 2025 per-protein log2 fold changes of the CRISPRi campaign's differential contrasts: 16 records, one per released contrast column. Figure 5b gives 14 single-guide CRISPRi strains against the non-target control strain, and Figure 6b the 2 knockout-plus-target-sgRNA strains against the same knockout with a non-targeting sgRNA.
ProteomeFoldChangeLim2025Dataset: Lim 2025 released proteome contrasts of the tolerization evolution campaign: four records, one per sheet, two evolved isolates over their parent IPL400 in M9 with 4 g/L glucose, with and without 4 g/L isoprenol. One record carries that sheet's per-protein log2 fold change with the p value, the BH adjusted p value and the Welch standard error.
ProteomeIshii2007Dataset: Ishii 2007 quantified absolute protein abundances by LC-MS/MS, in mg protein per g dry cell weight, on one set of glucose-limited chemostat cultures of E. coli K-12. One record is one culture: 24 single-gene Keio disruptants at a dilution rate of 0.2 per hour, plus the wild type at 0.1, 0.4, 0.5 and 0.7 per hour, 28 records.
ProteomeLim2025Dataset: Lim 2025 absolute proteome under isoprenol stress: the stacked-deletion parent IPL400 and the two evolved isolates the release quantifies, profiled by shotgun proteomics under 4 g/L isoprenol. Three records, one per strain, each its Top3 log2 abundances over 2,361, 2,361 and 2,332 protein keys, referenced to its own unstressed arm.
ProteomeLog10PercentDeSiqueira2025Datase: de Siqueira 2025 Data Set S1 on its third released scale: the mean of the three replicates' log10 percent-of-total abundance with its SD, for KT2440, the acetate-sensitive PT and four tolerized isolates in M9 with acetate, glucose or both. 17 records, one per sample over 1,730 protein groups; a mean of logs cannot be recovered from the other scales.
ProteomeMenasalvas2025Dataset: Menasalvas 2025 Supplementary Data 2 sheet 4: the shotgun proteome of the control TEAM-2595 and the two improved isoprenol producers TEAM-3174 and TEAM-3185, each sampled in the growth phase at OD600 0.7 and in the production phase at 24 h. Six records, one per sample over 2,090 loci and three replicates, referenced to the matching-phase control.
ProteomeMessner2021Dataset: Messner 2021 measured proteomes of one prototrophic BY4741 wild-type strain grown in synthetic minimal medium and treated overnight with 16 drugs (statins, azoles, antifolates), folic acid or FIN56 at 10 uM, by Scanning SWATH mass spectrometry. One record is one drug-treated run: per-protein DIA-NN MaxLFQ quantities, referenced to 24 DMSO runs (70 records).
ProteomeMessner2023Dataset: Messner 2023 measured proteomes of the prototrophic S. cerevisiae haploid gene-deletion collection by microflow SWATH-MS, each strain once, in synthetic minimal medium. One record is one knockout sample (4,699 strains, duplicate strains of one ORF kept apart): non-imputed MaxLFQ protein quantities, referenced to 388 replicates of a his3Δ HIS3-complemented control.
ProteomeMori2021Dataset: Mori 2021 measured absolute E. coli proteome abundances over 66 LC-MS samples by DIA/SWATH with xTop protein inference, spanning nutrient limitations, non-metabolic stresses and non-planktonic states. This class stores the Dataset EV9 absolute protein mass fractions, one record per loaded sample, seven of the 66, each one MG1655 culture in one medium.
ProteomeMuenzner2024Dataset: Muenzner 2024 measured proteomes of natural S. cerevisiae isolates of the 1,011-genomes panel by SWATH-MS (DIA-NN) in synthetic minimal medium. One record is one strain (794 isolates with a Peter genome plus FY4): released non-imputed, batch-corrected MaxLFQ quantities per protein, with each isolate genotype built off S288C (SI Table 3).
ProteomePercentDeSiqueira2025Dataset: de Siqueira 2025 Data Set S1 as percent of each sample's total abundance, the scale the paper's own dimensionality reduction runs on, for KT2440, the acetate-sensitive PT and four tolerized isolates in M9 with acetate, glucose or both. 17 records, one per released sample over 1,730 protein groups, each a replicate-wise mean of percentages with its SD.
ProteomeSchmidt2016Dataset: Schmidt 2016 measured absolute abundances of more than 2,300 proteins of E. coli K-12 BW25113 across 22 growth conditions in biological triplicates by label-free LC-MS. This class stores Table S6's protein copies per cell, one record per growth condition other than the glucose reference, 21 records of wild-type cultures.
ProteomeSrmSet1Schmidt2016Dataset: Schmidt 2016 also quantified 41 carbohydrate-metabolism proteins absolutely by selected reaction monitoring against synthetic heavy reference peptides. This class holds Table S2, the OGE-fractionated arm, 41 proteins in 19 conditions with a technical-replicate standard deviation. One record is one BW25113 growth condition, 18 records.
ProteomeSrmSet2Schmidt2016Dataset: Schmidt 2016's second absolute-quantification arm, selected reaction monitoring against synthetic heavy reference peptides on the unfractionated data set. This class holds Table S3, 31 proteins in 22 conditions with a biological-triplicate standard deviation. One record is one BW25113 growth condition, 21 records.
ProteomeZelezniak2018Dataset: Zelezniak 2018 measured the proteome of 97 kinase-deletion strains of S. cerevisiae plus wild type by SWATH-MS label-free quantification of 726 proteins. One record is one knockout strain: per-protein mean and standard error of batch-corrected log signal over at least two replicate samples, referenced to the wild-type parent.
PutidaPrecise321Lim2022Dataset: Lim 2022 putidaPRECISE321: 321 RNA-seq profiles of KT2440 and its derivatives over 118 conditions and 21 projects, 225 reprocessed from other studies and 96 generated for this paper. One record is one sample over 5,564 genes, carrying TPM back-transformed from the published log2(TPM + 1) matrix beside the paired featureCounts counts.
RbTnseqBorchert2023Dataset: Borchert 2023 lignin tolerance RB-TnSeq: 14 experiments in biological triplicate on a barcoded KT2440 transposon library, M9 with 20 mM glucose against eleven lignin-relevant stressors. 10,824 records over the 271 loci the Borchert 2024 compendium eliminated, one per locus and replicate arm, each a signed log2 gene fitness with its growth duration.
RbTnseqBorchert2024Dataset: Borchert 2024 fModules compendium: 332 RB-TnSeq samples of a barcoded KT2440 transposon library over 4,732 genes, with replicates not averaged. 1,372,280 records from the 290 kept samples, one per gene and sample, each the signed log2 gene fitness of that gene's insertion mutants under the sample's medium plus its carbon, nitrogen or stress variable.
RbTnseqPrice2018EcoliDataset: Price 2018's genome-wide mutant fitness compendium, E. coli BW25113 arm: the randomly barcoded Tn5 library KEIO ML9 assayed in the 162 successful BarSeq samples. One record is one gene in one sample, the signed log2 gene fitness with the paper's standard error, the maximum of its strain-consistency and read-count estimates.
RbTnseqTeteneva2024Dataset: Teteneva 2024 incubated a randomly barcoded Tn5 library of E. coli K-12 W3110 RpoS+ in lake water, filter-sterilized or not, sampling at days 2, 4 and 8. One record is one released Table S4 value, 66,162 in all: a gene's log2 barcode-count fitness against the day-0 culture in one water sample, filtration and day.
RbTnseqWetmore2015Dataset: Wetmore 2015, the RB-TnSeq method paper, grew the E. coli BW25113 Tn5 library KEIO ML9 in 101 condition samples, of which 92 passed the paper's quality rules. One record is one released gene in one kept sample: the normalized signed log2 gene fitness with its per-gene standard error and the released moderated t statistic.
RnaseqCaglar2017Dataset: Caglar 2017 measured mRNA by RNA-seq in wild-type E. coli REL606 across 34 Davis minimal medium conditions: four carbon sources, Mg2+ and Na+ series, exponential and stationary phase, and two starvation time courses. One record is one Table S2 library, 152 in all, holding read counts and TPM for 4,196 protein-coding genes.
RnaseqGuzman2018Dataset: Guzman 2018 released 14 RNA-seq libraries through its own GEO submission: two wild-type BW25113 libraries and twelve of Keio thrA, serB and ptsI deletion strains that grew after extended culture on glucose M9, each in biological duplicate. One record is one library, holding the released TPM matrix keyed by the release's own gene ids.
RnaseqLamoureux2023Dataset: PRECISE-1K (Lamoureux 2023) assembled 1,035 high-quality E. coli K-12 MG1655 RNA-seq profiles, all generated by one lab under one protocol and released as log2 of TPM plus 1 over 4,257 genes with per-sample metadata. One record is one sample, a biological-replicate library of a wild type or deletion strain, with TPM and read counts.
RnaseqPublicK12Lamoureux2023Dataset: Lamoureux 2023 also curated every publicly available E. coli K-12 RNA-seq run in the SRA and reprocessed it through the PRECISE-1K pipeline, keeping the 1,675 samples that passed the replicate-correlation threshold. One record is one reprocessed library of another lab, identified by its SRA experiment accession.
ScmdOhnuki2018Dataset: Ohnuki 2018 imaged heterozygous diploid deletions of 1,112 essential genes in BY4743 (one of two copies removed, kanMX4) grown in liquid YPD at 25 C, and quantified single-cell morphology with CalMorph. One record is one strain: a 501-trait vector of population averages and variation parameters, referenced to the mean of 114 wild-type replicates.
ScmdOhnuki2022Dataset: Ohnuki 2022 deleted each target gene in a drug-hypersensitive pdr1Δ pdr3Δ snq2Δ background, grew the quadruple deletions in liquid YPD at 25 C, triple-stained and imaged them, and quantified morphology with CalMorph. One record is one quadruple-deletion strain (1,979): a 501-trait vector, referenced to the mean of 749 replicates of the triple-deletion parent.
ScmdOhya2005Dataset: Ohya 2005 imaged the haploid BY4741 nonessential single-gene deletion collection (kanMX4) grown in YPD and quantified single-cell morphology of fixed log-phase cells with CalMorph. One record is one full deletion strain (4,718 in the matrix): a 501-trait vector of CalMorph averages and variation parameters, referenced to the mean of 122 wild-type replicates.
SmMicroarraySameith2015Dataset: Sameith 2015 profiled 82 single deletions of general stress transcription factors (BY4742, MATalpha, KanMX) on two-color microarrays against a common wild-type RNA reference in dye-swap, two cultures each for four measurements. One record is one single-deletion strain: per-gene log2 ratio versus the reference, stored as liquid SC at 30 C.
SmfBaryshnikova2010Dataset: Baryshnikova 2010 estimated single-mutant fitness from SGA colony sizes on control screens for 6,023 S. cerevisiae alleles: 4,635 nonessential kanMX deletions, 1,082 essential-gene DAmP hypomorphs and 306 temperature-sensitive alleles. One record is one allele: fitness normalized to a mode of 1.0 with a bootstrap standard error.
SmfCostanzo2016Dataset: Costanzo 2016 estimated single-mutant fitness of S. cerevisiae deletion, DAmP, temperature-sensitive and other alleles from SGA colony sizes averaged over replicate control screens at 26 C and 30 C on solid SGA selection medium. One record is one strain at one temperature: fitness relative to wild type with a bootstrap standard error.
SmfKuzmin2018Dataset: Kuzmin 2018 released single-mutant fitness from its SGA trigenic screen: array strains (kanMX deletions and temperature-sensitive alleles) and digenic-screen query strains, scored by colony size at 26 C on solid triple-mutant selection medium. One record is one array or query single mutant, with query SDs from Additional Data S4.
SmfKuzmin2020Dataset: Kuzmin 2020 estimated fitness of single-mutant query strains (kanMX deletions and other alleles) from colony sizes on a high-density array, 12 to 24 colony measurements per estimate, at 26 C on solid SGA triple-mutant selection medium. One record is one single-mutant query strain: fitness and bootstrap SD from Table S5.
SmfODuibhir2014Dataset: O'Duibhir 2014 measured doubling times of 1,312 S. cerevisiae gene-deletion strains from the OD600 growth slope in liquid synthetic complete medium with 2% glucose, averaging two biological replicate cultures. One record is one deletion strain: fitness as growth rate relative to wild type, 2 to the power of minus the released log2 relative doubling time.
SynthLethalityYeastSynthLethDbDataset: SynLethDB 2.0 aggregates S. cerevisiae synthetic lethal gene pairs from literature and databases such as BioGRID, each with its source, PubMed id and a normalized confidence score, but no medium or temperature. One record is one released gene pair (14,000), each gene stored by its released name and NCBI Entrez id, with the pair marked synthetic lethal.
SynthRescueYeastSynthLethDbDataset: SynLethDB 2.0 also collects S. cerevisiae synthetic rescue gene pairs from the same literature and database sources, with source and PubMed id but no medium, temperature or defined score. One record is one released gene pair (6,948), each gene stored by its released name and NCBI Entrez id, with the pair marked synthetic rescue.
TargetedMetabolomeRapp2026Dataset: Rapp 2026 screened an E. coli CRISPRi library, each strain the YYdCas9 background carrying one released spacer, and re-measured the accumulating strain-metabolite pairs on a second platform, the targeted LC-MS/MS screen of Table S6. One record is one strain, holding each measured metabolite's EIC peak-height fold change against the library median.
TfDeletionPseudobulkJackson2020Dataset: Jackson 2020 pooled 72 barcoded prototrophic diploid strains, six independent constructions each of eleven nitrogen-regulatory transcription-factor deletions and an HO-deletion control, grew them in eleven conditions and profiled them by 10x single-cell RNA-seq. One record is one strain in one condition: summed UMI counts of its cells (784 records).
TmfKuzmin2018Dataset: Kuzmin 2018 measured triple-mutant fitness by SGA, crossing double-mutant query strains against an array of kanMX deletion and temperature-sensitive alleles and scoring colony size at 26 C on solid triple-mutant selection medium. One record is one trigenic query x array cross: combined-mutant fitness with a sample SD over colonies (Data S1).
TmfKuzmin2020Dataset: Kuzmin 2020 measured triple-mutant fitness by SGA, crossing 240 double-mutant query strains against about 1,200 array strains (Table S1) and against the genome-wide nonessential and temperature-sensitive arrays in pilot screens (Table S3), at 26 C. One record is one trigenic query x array cross in one screen: fitness and colony SD.
TmiKuzmin2018Dataset: Kuzmin 2018 scored trigenic genetic interactions from SGA colony sizes of double-mutant query strains crossed against an array of deletion and temperature-sensitive alleles at 26 C. One record is one gene triple from a trigenic query x array cross: the adjusted interaction score tau and its P-value, with zero as the reference (Data S1).
TmiKuzmin2020Dataset: Kuzmin 2020 scored trigenic interactions from SGA screens of 240 double-mutant query strains against about 1,200 array strains (Table S1) and against genome-wide arrays in pilot screens (Table S3), at 26 C. One record is one gene triple from one screen's trigenic query x array cross: the adjusted interaction score tau and its P-value.
TranscriptionFactorKnockoutChoe2019Datas: Choe 2019 monitored growth of 62 transcription-factor knockout strains of the Keio collection in M9 glucose medium, in a 96-well plate on a microplate reader at 37 C. ValerolactamTiterThompson2019Dataset: Thompson 2019 valerolactam titers of a four-strain ladder, each strain a lysine-fed producer carrying the plasmid pBADT-davBA-ORF26 with lactam hydrolase, aminotransferase and racemase deletions stacked.
